note: The smaller and more densely wooded of Mashamoquet Brook State Park's two campgrounds, a short walk from the brook; its own entrance is off Route 44, and the camp office is at the Wolf Den Campground a short drive away. Pets not allowed. Pond swimming is no longer available since the pond was drained (ReserveAmerica, read 2026-11-11). --Claude
summary: ctparks + ReserveAmerica + 2016 map: $14/$24 confirmed; 18 sites, no hookups, RA posts 35 ft on every site (possibly a placeholder); no showers or running water, composting/portable toilets; 2026 season May 1-Oct 12 confirmed (now manual); pin ~330 m off onto Route 44; park phone found; note cleaned (booking, season and field-held text dropped).
flags: PIN: stored 41.86129,-71.98233 sits on Route 44 at the main park entrance road, not in the campground. DEEP's map puts the campground entrance farther west on Route 44 with the road running ESE to a loop about 90 m south of Route 44; imagery shows that loop at about 41.8599,-71.9850 under canopy (the sites themselves are hidden by trees). Recommend moving the pin to about 41.8598,-71.9856 (the middle of sites 41-60 on the map); confidence moderate because of the canopy.

SEPARATE CAMPGROUNDS: yes. Brook (320 Mashamoquet Road, its own entrance off Route 44) and Wolf Den (147 Wolf Den Drive, its own entrance road) are about 1.9 km apart on corrected pins, each with its own entrance. The database already holds both (4061 Brook, 4060 Wolf Den).

POTABLE WATER (stored false, derived, left alone): official pages disagree. ctparks' park page says 'Composting toilets (no running water or showers)' and RA says the loop 'does not have running water', but ctparks.com/camping says for this campground 'Drinking water is not available prior to Memorial Day or after Labor Day', implying drinking water in summer. Not written either way; the reviewer may want to clear the derived false.

SITE LENGTHS: ReserveAmerica shows 35 ft back-in on every site in both loops (all 51 listed sites), which may be a placeholder. The old note's 'Gravel roads fit moderately sized RVs/larger trailers' has no official source I could find and is dropped; RA's 35 ft passes 23 ft either way.

SITE LIST: RA's list holds 16 Brook sites (043-046, 048-057, 059, 060); sites 41 and 42 appear on DEEP's map and in RA's own description ('18 sites numbered 41 through 60 (no sites #47 and 58)') but not in the bookable list.
PHONE: stored empty. ctparks lists 'Park office: (860) 928-6121' (the camp office is at Wolf Den).

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): DEEP's map draws the brook about 35-50 m north of sites 59 and 60 through dense woods; the park page itself calls the campground 'a short walk to the river'. Not waterfront.
DUMP: the park's only dump station (at Wolf Den) is 'currently CLOSED' (ctparks) / 'closed until further notice' (RA).
